sample_posts.text: KOREAN MEDIA: SK HYNIX SUBSIDIARY SOLIDIGM IS PURSUING PLANS TO BUILD TWO NAND FABS AT THE MARCY NANOCENTER IN NEW YORK AT A TOTAL COST OF $100 BILLION.

📊Winbond (2344 TT) earnings call | 3Q26 update #2  Winbond sees further upside in Q4 customized memory contract prices. Its next major expansion, Kaohsiung Module B, is expected to begin limited shipments in 2H29, with full capacity coming online in 2030.  Management’s outlook:

📊Winbond (2344 TT) earnings call | 3Q26 update #1  Q3 revenue rose 278% YoY and operating profit jumped nearly twelvefold. Higher pricing and a richer product mix drove the gains, with memory gross margin reaching 73.9%.  Key results: • Revenue: NT$82.33bn, +37.6% QoQ / +278.2%

📊Winbond (2344 TT) earnings call | 3Q26 update #3  Major MLCC suppliers are turning to Winbond’s silicon capacitor foundry service. Management says most of its existing capacity of several thousand wafers per month in Kaohsiung Module A has already been booked.  The model:
